salary_details.details: Selected candidates are engaged as Casual Assignees and paid on a per-day or per-day-per-shift basis, as shown below. The notification clarifies that a maximum of 7 (seven) assignments may be given per month, and empanelment does not constitute a regular post.

how_to_apply: RNU Guwahati Recruitment 2026 applications must be submitted offline, in the prescribed format, along with supporting documents.
Download or prepare the application in the prescribed format given at Annexure A of the notification.
Attach copies of required documents: certificates of educational qualification, proof of age, proof of residence, and experience certificate (where applicable).
A separate detailed CV may also be submitted along with the prescribed format, if more detail is needed; however, submitting the prescribed proforma is mandatory.
Place the application and documents in an envelope superscribed "Empanelment of (Name of the position) for RNU, DDK, Guwahati".
Send the envelope by post to: RNU Head, Doordarshan Kendra, R.G. Baruah Road, Guwahati–781024.
Ensure the application reaches the office within one month from the date of publication of the notification on the website.
important_instructions: Empanelment under the casual category does not constitute a regular post. Empanelled candidates shall not have any claim for regular/permanent employment. Selected candidates may be assigned a maximum of 7 (seven) assignments per month. Applications without the required enclosures will be summarily rejected, and no further correspondence will be entertained. Canvassing in any form will lead to rejection of the application. No application fee is payable. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the test/interview.

rows.category: Casual News Reader / News Anchor (Assamese & English)

content_sections.heading: RNU Guwahati Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility differs by category. Candidates must be of Indian origin and residing in Assam, in addition to meeting the qualification requirements below.

rows.essential_qualification: Degree from a recognized university; proficiency in the concerned language; camera-friendly appearance with a good broadcasting voice; correct pronunciation, accent and modulation; knowledge of current regional/Indian/foreign affairs; acquaintance with important personalities in the region, India and abroad. Preferable: journalism background, related professional/academic background, TV/Radio media experience. Desirable: knowledge of English and Hindi, ability to interview people, ability to write and report news including sports.

Degree from a recognized university; Degree/Diploma in Journalism from a recognized university; minimum 3 years' experience in work relating to news broadcasting/news organization. Desirable: acquaintance with national/international affairs, matriculate in the relevant language.

Degree from a recognized university; Degree/Diploma in Journalism/Mass Communication from a recognized university. Desirable: 2 years' experience in the relevant field, exposure to new media operations or proven aptitude in this field.

Degree from a recognized university; Degree/Diploma in TV & Radio production from a recognized university. Desirable: matriculate in the relevant language, exposure to the audio-visual medium and proven aptitude in this field.
10+2 from a recognized board; Degree/Diploma in Film & Video Editing from a recognized university; 2 years' experience in the relevant field.
10+2 from a recognized board; Certificate in Computer Application. Desirable: one year's experience in the relevant field.
10+2 from a recognized board; speed of 80 w.p.m. in shorthand and 40 w.p.m. in computer typing.

faq.question: Q1. What is RNU Guwahati Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is an empanelment drive by the Regional News Unit, Doordarshan Kendra, Guwahati for Casual Assignees across seven categories, including News Reader/Anchor, Assistant News Editor, Assistant Website Editor, Broadcast Assistant, Video Editor, CG Operator, and Stenographer.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: The number of vacancies is not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the office within one month from the date of publication of the notification on the official website; an exact calendar date is not separately given.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by category, ranging from 10+2 with relevant certificates/diplomas to a university degree with journalism or mass communication qualifications and relevant experience. See the eligibility section above for category-wise details.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Age limits vary by category: 21–40 years for Casual News Reader/News Anchor, 25–50 years for Assistant News Editor, and 21–50 years for Assistant Website Editor, Broadcast Assistant, Video Editor, CG Operator, and Stenographer.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: No application fee is payable for any category under this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline, in the prescribed format with required documents, by post to the RNU Head, Doordarshan Kendra, R.G. Baruah Road, Guwahati–781024.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The notification refers to a test/interview (no TA/DA is paid for attending it), but does not specify further stages.
